--- title: "Variant and Gene Context" --- ## Start with the exact variant A variant is a change in a DNA sequence. A gene can contain many different variants, and each variant may have a different effect. Start with the exact allele, transcript, protein change, condition, and data source. Gene expression and protein information come later. They should not hide uncertainty or disagreement about the variant itself. ClinVar is a public NCBI archive. It stores submitted reports about human variants and health. ClinVar combines submissions and supporting evidence, but it does not independently change a submitted classification. This lesson uses five ClinVar-linked examples related to the heart failure scenario. The table is a saved teaching dataset. ClinVar records can change, so you should check the live record before using an annotation in clinical work. ::: {.module-activity} ## Inspect the Candidates This is the complete analysis from the variant background notebook. It loads the table, checks its structure, and creates a smaller summary. Choose **Run Code** to try it in your browser. ```{pyodide} from pathlib import Path import pandas as pd DATA_DIR = Path("data") if Path("data").exists() else Path("../data") variants = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "variants.csv") variants ``` ```{pyodide} required_columns = { "gene_symbol", "hgvs_c", "hgvs_p", "condition", "clinvar_variation_id", "clinical_significance", } missing_columns = required_columns.difference(variants.columns) assert not missing_columns, f"Missing required columns: {sorted(missing_columns)}" assert variants["gene_symbol"].is_unique, "Expected one teaching variant per gene" assert variants["clinvar_variation_id"].notna().all() print(f"Validated {len(variants)} candidate variants.") ``` ```{pyodide} candidate_summary = ( variants.loc[ :, [ "gene_symbol", "hgvs_c", "hgvs_p", "condition", "clinical_significance", ], ] .sort_values(["condition", "gene_symbol"]) .reset_index(drop=True) ) candidate_summary ``` ::: ::: {.knowledge-check data-answer="Tissue expression" data-correct="GTEx adds tissue expression later." data-incorrect="Protein change and condition are already in the starting table."}
Which field comes from a later evidence layer instead of the starting variant table?

::: ::: {.knowledge-check data-answer="False" data-correct="Expression shows biological context. It does not prove pathogenicity." data-incorrect="Gene expression and variant pathogenicity are different types of evidence."}
Expression of a candidate gene in heart tissue is enough to classify its variant as pathogenic.
